command:
import pathlib,runpy,sys
marker=pathlib.Path(sys.argv[1]); script=sys.argv[2]
def audit(event,args):
 if event=="subprocess.Popen" and not marker.exists():
  with marker.open("xb") as f: f.write(b"CHILD_LAUNCHED")
sys.addaudithook(audit)
sys.path.insert(0,str(pathlib.Path(script).parent))
sys.argv=[script]+sys.argv[3:]
runpy.run_path(script,run_name="__main__")
records.expected_reason: Output directory must be fresh and non-existing
